WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.NorthAmericaSeason AS season,
        f.DateKey,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS day_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
        ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS c
        ON f.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimGeography AS g
        ON c.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
    WHERE g.ContinentName = 'North America'
    GROUP BY
        d.NorthAmericaSeason,
        f.DateKey
)
SELECT
    season,
    avg(day_sales) AS avg_daily_sales
FROM daily_sales
GROUP BY season
ORDER BY avg_daily_sales DESC
LIMIT 1
